title: Balloon Fight
build: Balloon Fight (USA).nes, the original cartridge program on an NROM-128 board (mapper 0): 16 KB of PRG at $C000 (mirrored at $8000) and 8 KB of CHR, with an NES 2.0 header; CRC32 of the PRG and CHR 401349A8

tools.emulator: jsnes 2.1.0 (npm), in the kit's server (kit/nes/jsnes_server.mjs), an NTSC NES; check-emulator 36 passed, 0 failed, on 18 October 2026
tools.disassembler: regenerator2000 0.9.20 in its NES mode, on the project kit/nes/project.py builds from the snapshot
tools.host: macOS 27.0.1 on Apple silicon (a Mac mini)
tools.browser: Google Chrome 141 (the Mac's own), headless with a profile under tools/chrome-profile, for the page screenshots

accuracy.note: 30 code and 30 data comments; a fresh agent; every comment that repeated a wrong detail corrected with it
the sound driver, the phase renderer and the flight port, each held to the game's code or the emulator; the sound effect names corrected from the recordings are counted in the annotation

exclude: the cartridge's RAM area: an NROM board has nothing there, and the snapshot holds zeros
the PRG ROM's mirror: an NROM-128 cartridge's 16 KB is at $8000 and again at $C000, and the vectors and the program counter use the $C000 half

regions: the sixteen phase layouts: screens, clouds, propellers, birds, platforms
the physics tables by actor type
the effects' register blocks and the note tables
